gamePatch.label: Game update
gamePatch.summary: Krao Cave and Draupnir gain Hard expeditions, with a new path to the Ariel Daevanion board. The update also brings a Kina shop event and several Abyss and class fixes.
gamePatch.expeditionRules: Krao Cave and Draupnir Hard require item level 2,600. Boss Frenzy begins after 4 minutes, and each player has 3 revives.
gamePatch.expeditionRewards: Rewards include Ariel Fragment (Bound), more Kina than Normal, a chance at Philosopher's Stone: Revelation (Bound) and Expedition Hero Artwork. The stone can also be chosen as a guaranteed reward.
gamePatch.expeditionMaterials: Both Hard expeditions can award all three Unique crafting materials: Wrathful Mind, Wrathful Will and Wrathful Ego. The Ariel Fragment awarded differs by dungeon.
gamePatch.arielBoard: Ariel unlocks at level 45. Preview its 153 active nodes for your class, including each node’s point cost and stat bonuses. Each Daevanion Crystal: Ariel (Bound) grants 1 Ariel point.
gamePatch.arielMorph: Use Special → Daevanion to turn 100 Ariel Fragment: Krao (Bound) or 100 Ariel Fragment: Draupnir (Bound) into 1 Daevanion Crystal: Ariel (Bound). Each dungeon recipe has its own limit of 30 per character. Under Special → Consumables, either fragment can instead produce 5 Enhance Stones per fragment without a limit.
gamePatch.arielAchievements: Krao Hard achievements award skins at 5, 10 and 15 clears. Draupnir Hard skin milestones are 5, 10, 15, 18, 21, 23 and 25 clears. Hero’s Footsteps tracks Expedition Hero Artwork, and Benediction of Light tracks Ariel nodes. Open a milestone to see its exact rewards.
gamePatch.eventSchedule: From October 21 until the December 16 maintenance in Europe (December 15 in the Americas), Resurrection Spiritstones (Season 1) are sold for Kina under Shop → Wind Breeze Merchants.
gamePatch.eventShop: Each server can buy two weekly steps: 30 stones for 25,000 Kina, then 30 stones for 50,000 Kina.
gamePatch.chanter: Chanter: Spinning Strike's missing skill effects are fixed.
gamePatch.sorcerer: Sorcerer: Cold Storm's stacked Frostbite damage, effect scaling and Specialty 1 reapplication are fixed. Fire Wall no longer deals its extra damage to targets without Embers.
gamePatch.abyss: The Abyss player cap increases. Lower Abyss Dimensional Core and Abyss boss HP increase; Kaira and Argo receive slightly larger collision hitboxes.
gamePatch.traces: Empyrean Traces blocked by Halloween decorations at Dawn Legion Base and Zumion Village in Verteron move to accessible locations.
gamePatch.market: Market listing restrictions for gathered materials are adjusted based on gameplay history; eligibility may change for some players.
gamePatch.otherFixes: Duplicate Movement Controls settings are removed, and a mismatch between a title's actual effect and its item tooltip is fixed.
gamePatch.databaseSummary: Explore the updated Hard expedition rewards, Ariel boards with node costs and stat bonuses, fragment conversion recipes, and achievement milestones with their skin rewards. Item pages now connect the materials, recipes and rewards, with bound variants kept separate.

updates.halloweenTradersNote: — Each mission's Where to spend section links to four trader locations on the map. Open a trader to browse their event items.
updates.questsNote: — Follow objectives, see rewards and unlocks, and jump to relevant map locations.
updates.titlesNote: — See how to earn each title, compare stat bonuses, and mark the ones you own.
updates.challengesNote: — Compare Nightmare bosses, challenge levels and rewards to choose what to tackle next.
updates.achievementsNote: — Review milestone objectives, required counts and rewards to plan your progress.
